text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер loses the race. But unlike
before, she
vows with a positive attitude
to learn from this
defeat for the next
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She also promises Мэдзиро МакКуин and
Mejiro
Ryan a rematch before the two
head off to train
for their next race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Convinced that she can now run well in a
bigger
race, I suggest that she run in the
autumn Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер finds the strength to keep
herself
from falling back to her reluctant
ways and makes
up her mind to tackle
the big race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
